programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Tuan Ru Yang berjanji kepada isteri dan cucunya, Puteri Yu Chang untuk meyakinkan Shao Shang supaya berpisah dengan Bu Yi. Tapi selepas berbual dengan Shao Shang, dia menyatakan sebaliknya.

programme.title: LET ME TAKE YOUR PULSE

programme.title: HEALING HEROES

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)

programme.title: GREAT TIMES

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17

programme.title: CANTON FLAVOR SEASON 8

programme.title: TOGETHER, HERE WE ARE

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: Guqin Music Art
programme.desc: The guqin is an instrument with a history of over 3,000 years. Yet in all that time, its design and sound have remained virtually unchanged. In 2003, the guqin and its music were proclaimed as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO. But how has this ancient instrument withstood the musical test of time? How do its slow, gentle melodies resonate in fast-paced modern China? In this episode of The Inheritors, we explore guqin music art's history, development in modern days, and its future.

programme.title: Blossom China
programme.desc: Every year when the flowers come into full bloom, countless people across China set out for the country’s most popular flower-viewing destinations to enjoy nature’s colorful spectacle, fueling an increasingly vibrant "flower-tourism" economy. What ecological progress has made this possible, and how is it reshaping local communities? In the 30-minute CGTN special Blossom China, host Liu Qiuyuan, reporter Idah, and host Martin visit the “Train to Spring” at Juyongguan in Beijing, the peony-filled China National Flower Garden and Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, and the breathtaking Baili Azalea Scenic Area in Bijie, Guizhou—sharing the stories behind the blossoms through a unique lens.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Blossom China
programme.desc: Every year when the flowers come into full bloom, countless people across China set out for the country’s most popular flower-viewing destinations to enjoy nature’s colorful spectacle, fueling an increasingly vibrant "flower-tourism" economy. What ecological progress has made this possible, and how is it reshaping local communities? In the 30-minute CGTN special Blossom China, host Liu Qiuyuan, reporter Idah, and host Martin visit the “Train to Spring” at Juyongguan in Beijing, the peony-filled China National Flower Garden and Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, and the breathtaking Baili Azalea Scenic Area in Bijie, Guizhou—sharing the stories behind the blossoms through a unique lens.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Blossom China
programme.desc: Every year when the flowers come into full bloom, countless people across China set out for the country’s most popular flower-viewing destinations to enjoy nature’s colorful spectacle, fueling an increasingly vibrant "flower-tourism" economy. What ecological progress has made this possible, and how is it reshaping local communities? In the 30-minute CGTN special Blossom China, host Liu Qiuyuan, reporter Idah, and host Martin visit the “Train to Spring” at Juyongguan in Beijing, the peony-filled China National Flower Garden and Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, and the breathtaking Baili Azalea Scenic Area in Bijie, Guizhou—sharing the stories behind the blossoms through a unique lens.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty – it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret – it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Clothing woven in the mountains
programme.desc: "In Longsheng, southern China, ethnic communities have lived for generations among the same mountains and rivers. The landscape of terraced fields stretches across the valleys, carrying layered cultural memories. In this episode, CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipino singer Eliza Arce travel to Huangluo Yao Village. Beginning with the Red Yao tradition of sun-drying clothes, they explore the colours, craftsmanship, and everyday wisdom woven into these garments. Their journey culminates in a vibrant bonfire gathering, where different communities come together in celebration."

programme.title: Machante Malakha
programme.desc: Sajeevan, a simple bus conductor, marries the intensely affectionate Bijimol. However, as their marriage unfolds, her deep-seated control issues begin to create hurdles in Sajeevan's life.

programme.title: Airaa
programme.desc: After fleeing to her grandmother's village, Yamuna is haunted by a spirit. Meanwhile, Amudhan, a fellow villager, investigates a series of murders occurring in the region.

programme.title: Kadaisi Vivasayi
programme.desc: Mayandi, a farmer, is asked by the villagers to grow paddy for an annual temple festival. However, he gets arrested under false charges while his crop gets ruined due to neglect.

programme.title: Kick
programme.desc: A young advertising professional seizes the opportunity of posing as the son of a CEO with the intention of inheriting a global company.

programme.title: Ratchagan
programme.desc: A man with anger issues falls in love with a woman but later, the lady's father demands him to manage his rage within three months in order to marry his daughter.

programme.title: Dakini
programme.desc: Four old women, Mollikutty, Saroja, Rosemary and Vilasini, call themselves Dakini and have a friend in Kuttappi. However, trouble ensues when Molly's long-lost lover, Kuttan Pillai, reunites with her.

programme.title: Rajaputhiran
programme.desc: Chellaiyah, a devout farmer, sees farming as sacred and dislikes his son's choice to work elsewhere. However, when his son gets involved with criminals, Chellaiyah intervenes to rescue him.

programme.title: HUNT
programme.desc: A lesson in education for a forensic postgraduate takes an unwanted turn when the skeletal remains she stumbles upon brings forth something sinister.

programme.title: Azadi

programme.desc: Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak, four friends strive to navigate the challenges of their life along with managing their interpersonal relationships.

programme.title: Bomb
programme.desc: Revolves around the people of the land and the immense capacity of humanity to stick together through anything.

programme.title: Pallotty 90s Kids
programme.desc: Leaving behind his bustling city life, a man returns to his hometown, where a reunion with his childhood companion sparks a wave of sentimental memories.

programme.title: Kodai (Tamil)

programme.title: Nenu Leni Naa Premakatha
programme.desc: Connected with the help of a radio, a couple begins to fall in love with one another. However, they soon realise their love literally transcends space and time.

programme.title: Kadhal Desam

programme.title: Mandakini
programme.desc: Ambili's accidental sip of alcohol reveals a hidden past with Sujith, a man who wronged her. Later, her family confronts the dark truth about her secrets.

programme.title: Parking
programme.desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

programme.title: Thekku Vadakku
programme.desc: A retired engineer and a rice mill owner's feud for land keeps the entire town entertained as they battle to determine the winner.

programme.title: Kadaram Kondan
programme.desc: Vasu, a doctor, rescues KK, a criminal, from getting murdered in the hospital. However, when Vasu's wife gets kidnapped, he is asked to get KK out in exchange for his wife's safe return.

programme.title: Vyasanasametham Bandhumithradhikal
programme.desc: In a small town, a shopkeeper's life turns chaotic when his mother-in-law passes away and his daughter begins challenging traditional expectations about her upcoming marriage.

programme.title: Eleven
programme.desc: A seasoned police officer begins an investigation after a series of gruesome murders targeting twins comes to light. However, he soon encounters a sinister game of psychological manipulation.

programme.title: After School Club
programme.desc: The Singer-songwridol who brings us comforting and relatable music, JEONG SEWOON! JEONG SEWOON is back with his 6th mini-album ‘Quiz’, and he is coming to ASC to meet the global ‘Haengwoon’. Far apart, but together in heart! We’ve got a lot of prizes ready for those who participate on After School Club, so if you want to make some special memories, don’t hesitate!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Dabda x I’m LIVE by Dabda
[Intro] This is our instrumental intro track that announces the start of our performances
[여름놀이 / Summer Game] When this summer game comes to an end, we will all burst into tears
[Journey] Pack your holiday luggage to this song!
[Flower Tail] Let’s sail toward the horizon with a shipful of tropical flowers!
[Surfer] Join us to indulge in the cool, vast ocean

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for AMHO x I’m LIVE by AMHO
[As always] We hope you imagine the lyrics in your mind [The flower in a vase] This song is our take on sophistication, featuring various instrumental solos in a mellow vibe. When this summer game comes to an end, we will all burst into tears. [Fire] It’s a fire! Please enjoy how the song builds with an exciting beat and vocals in unison [Let me dance] Let’s sing and dance together to the beat! [Wind] You can enjoy our explosive energy hidden in refreshing sounds!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for 1415 x I’m LIVE by 1415
[SURFER] A taste of summer!
[Draw The Line] This is our biggest hit to date, good to listen to at any time
[naps!] Take a 30-minute nap to be at your best!
[COFFEE] Imagine being at a coffee shop and enjoy your heart’s groove
[TROUBLE] This song will linger in your ears for a long time

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for debtors x I’m LIVE by debtors
[5510] One-way love can still be true if you maintain the right speed and distance. Experience the thrill and heartbreak of one-sided love with this upbeat song. [Why Am I?] We see chairs everywhere we go,but some look so weak and fragile, making us wonder if it’s safe to sit on them. Please focus on the lyrics and enjoy the song to the fullest. [Barking Dogs] It’s not always pleasant to stay in a place where everything is fleeting. Please focus on the lyrics to enjoy the song to the fullest. [Mast] We sometimes have to offer the last cigarette in the pack. The song’s relaxed yet explosive sounds express that frustration. [Relativity] Many become more lenient when they get tipsy. When they get really drunk, however, they become more belligerent, especially if you are late. This song is about that funny switch.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Jeon Jin Hee x I’m LIVE by Jeon Jin Hee
[Should We Leave] This is the lead single from my third album. Anywhere works for me as long as we can be together. I wrote this song in hopes of overcoming the fear of everything disappearing. [Without Anyone Knowing] With only the acoustic guitar, this story somehow makes me feel sad. [Be Drunk] This new arrangement will excite you for sure! [A Trivial Story] This song features a blunt drumbeat and bass tone. The way the rhythm flows always makes me so happy. [ Unable to Speak That We Miss Each Other] Please enjoy the guitar riffs that evoke images of flickering lights at night.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Dasutt x I’m LIVE by Dasutt
[Like a Sea] Let’s listen to the sea quietly. [Camel] Please enjoy the contrast between the melody and the lyrics. [I really hope I arrive safely] This song features a calm start and an explosive end. [Youth] This is our message to young adults who work relentlessly for their dreams. Let’s sing the song together!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Instruction Manual for HANRORO x I’m LIVE by HANRORO <Take-off> It’s the perfect song for the opening with a grand band sound! <Seasweed> I hope you feel the freedom of the seaweed floating in the sea. <I'm happy> This song aims to instill love in the world. <Let Me Love My Youth> It’s a monologue of a sprout that’s afraid of the upcoming spring. <Don’t be afraid to fail> Please dance with me and enjoy the rhythm!

JO YURI has debuted with her ‘GLASSY’ charms that sparkle infinitely.She is coming to ASC with her single album [GLASSY].
Far apart, but together in heart!
We’ve got a lot of prizes ready for those who participate on After School Club, so if you want to make some special memories, don’t hesitate!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Jeon Jin Hee x I’m LIVE by Jeon Jin Hee
[Should We Leave] This is the lead single from my third album. Anywhere works for me as long as we can be together. I wrote this song in hopes of overcoming the fear of everything disappearing. [Without Anyone Knowing] With only the acoustic guitar, this story somehow makes me feel sad. [Be Drunk] This new arrangement will excite you for sure! [A Trivial Story] This song features a blunt drumbeat and bass tone. The way the rhythm flows always makes me so happy. [ Unable to Speak That We Miss Each Other] Please enjoy the guitar riffs that evoke images of flickering lights at night.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Dasutt x I’m LIVE by Dasutt
[Like a Sea] Let’s listen to the sea quietly. [Camel] Please enjoy the contrast between the melody and the lyrics. [I really hope I arrive safely] This song features a calm start and an explosive end. [Youth] This is our message to young adults who work relentlessly for their dreams. Let’s sing the song together!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Instruction Manual for HANRORO x I’m LIVE by HANRORO <Take-off> It’s the perfect song for the opening with a grand band sound! <Seasweed> I hope you feel the freedom of the seaweed floating in the sea. <I'm happy> This song aims to instill love in the world. <Let Me Love My Youth> It’s a monologue of a sprout that’s afraid of the upcoming spring. <Don’t be afraid to fail> Please dance with me and enjoy the rhythm!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN

programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - PUISI NUSANTARA
programme.desc: Puisi Nusantara is a magazine-style programme celebrating the richness of Malay literature and culture, featuring cultural figures and traditional music performances

programme.title: Malaysia Tonight
programme.desc: Malaysia Tonight is a live flagship news programme featuring comprehensive coverage of Malaysia’s top stories, alongside selected international news and sports segments for a broader perspective.

programme.title: On The Table (OTT)
programme.desc: 'On The Table' is a talk show that explores a range of topics, emphasizing Malaysia's current issues and trends. It also seeks to position Malaysia as an appealing investment and business hub for foreign investors, featuring insights from opinion leaders and influential figures.

programme.title: World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation news program, which brings together content material in the form of features and human interest from ASEAN countries and around the world.

programme.title: Behind The Mic
programme.desc: 'Behind The Mic' is an interview program by a radio channel broadcast to a television platform that discusses a wide range of current issues both locally and internationally, including culture, health, education, and much more. In addition to featuring prominent and influential personalities, the show also explores key topics that impact global society. Each episode offers in-depth insights from special guests who are experts in their fields, providing viewers with an opportunity to gain a broader perspective on the world around them.

programme.title: Global Voices
programme.desc: 'Global Voices' is a mixed-slot program featuring a blend of engaging content, including both previously aired shows and fresh new programs that resonate with a global audience. Focusing on current issues, culture, technology, and international harmony, Global Voices aims to connect viewers with a broader perspective of the world. The program also offers inspiring stories and discussions from diverse cultural backgrounds, bringing audiences closer to the realities of our increasingly interconnected global community.

programme.title: Fintech
programme.desc: Apa itu Fintech atau Financial Technology? Bagaimana perkembangan dan manfaatnya? Saksikan Fintech untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut bersama panelis undangan setiap minggu.

programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。
